governance.attested_by: nyiso-53 li-tsl keeper promotion 2026-07-06 (owner decision, lane L-11)
governance.note: The nyiso-52 recipe (nyiso-41 meta at HEAD + PR-#1442 re-derived floors + measured downstate CT citygate premium) plus two structural changes, neither tuned to any residual: (1) nyiso_li_lcr_tsl (issue #1345) — the published Zone-K locality import limit caps the NYC->Long_Island link in the HB14-21 design-condition window, REPLACING the residual-identified 0.45 all-hours self-supply energy floor (the nyiso_local_selfsupply forcing channel is eliminated outright; rule 19: replace, never stack); (2) use_plant_emission_rates_v2 (G-39 sec-9.6 ride-along) — measured CAMPD plant-specific CO2 rates, first NYISO backcast use, after fixing the silent unreachability of the flag from the CAMPD-bins path (the v2-off attribution twin 2026-07-06-nyiso53-v2off-twin isolates the flip: C1-2024 ST_GAS FAIL->PASS, C3a +2.4/+1.8/+0.4pp, mean price +$0.61). The CC_REGULAR econ_high de-leak (1.0) is NOT re-armed.
governance.residuals_note: OWNER PROMOTED WITH EYES OPEN on the rule-20 C8 breach: CT_PEAKER floor-forced share 92.7/86.7/56.6% of class energy (cap 10%). Absolute floor-forced CT energy FELL to 1.486/1.555/1.455 TWh (the nyiso-48 baseline's selfsupply floor alone forced 1.84/2.87/1.86 TWh, and that channel is now deleted; remaining forcing is entirely the PR-#1442 windowed temperature ramps) — the share is high because the class's ECONOMIC energy collapses without reserve-scarcity price formation: the pure-ED LP credits idle peakers as reserve, so nothing commits them (issue #1344, the downstate-reserve handoff's confirmed root cause, data-blocked on the Ask-B condition-varying requirement series). Same attribution for the C3c tail (0/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42) and the CT_PEAKER grid volume under-run (1.28/1.44/2.40 vs actual 2.26/2.13/2.84 TWh, within C1 band). These are open root-cause threads with a filed external data ask - not fit moves, and NOT to be closed by re-arming offer markups (rules 13/26).

_open_items: (1) #1344 reserve-scarcity formation - data-blocked on the Ask-B measured condition-varying reserve-requirement series (docs/handoffs/nyiso-data-asks-2026-07.md); the in-LP channel (nyiso_dynamic_reserve_requirements) is built, default-off, hard-errors without the data; LOYO 2023-2025 is its promotion gate. (2) G-13 CT offer grounding - Ask-A LI/NYC LDC citygate/interruptible delivered-gas intake supersedes the statewide-monthly stand-in. (3) Data-blocked eastern winter hub (Iroquois Z2, Ask-C) - inherited from nyiso-41 unchanged. (4) 2024 ST_GAS C1 passes by 0.02 TWh (-2.92 vs +/-2.94 band) - the v2 flip closed the -3.25 fail; the class remains the tightest volume margin.
